column1: # Golden corpus for Arabic search rules V1: input<TAB>expected key, both checked by hand against the rule table.
# Escapes: \uXXXX (UTF-16 code unit), \n, \t, \r, \\. Lines starting with # are comments; an empty expected is "".
# Teh marbuta and alef maksura fold in the key only
# Tashkeel, tatweel, and Quranic marks are deleted inside words
# Persian, Urdu, Kurdish, and Maghrebi letters
# Presentation forms, as copied out of PDFs
# Decomposed input folds like composed input
# Separators: every non-alphabet character splits words, and runs collapse
# Invisible formatting characters are deleted without a space
